title: managa app manifest
description: Place this file at managa.app.json in the root of a compatible app repository.

id.description: Stable app id. Derived from the name when omitted.

name.description: Display name shown on dashboard cards.

description.description: Short description shown on dashboard cards.

icon.description: Emoji or short text used as the card icon.

mcp.description: An app-owned MCP server. managa bridges its tools through /mcp using the namespace prefix.

component.description: Component hosting the MCP endpoint. Defaults to server when present, otherwise client.

path.description: Absolute HTTP path of the Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint on that component.

namespace.description: Prefix for bridged tool names. Defaults to the app id.

dir.description: Component directory, relative to the app root.

start.description: Command used to run the component in the foreground.

install.description: Optional command run when node_modules is missing.

port.description: Preferred port. managa reallocates if it is taken.

healthPath.description: HTTP path polled while the component boots.

readyTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the health endpoint. Defaults to 45000.

buildOutput.description: Artefact checked after building, such as .next or dist.
